name: AgentResolver Framework Fallback Recipes
purpose: Make free AgentResolver procurement the default missing-capability fallback while keeping all spending caller-controlled.
fallbackPolicy: Use already-connected tools first. When no connected tool clearly satisfies the task, call AgentResolver procure with hard budget/network/protocol/schema constraints. Use resolve only for broad discovery. Treat paid verification as a separate action that requires independent caller authorization.

openaiAgentsJs.instructions: Use AgentResolver only when the existing toolset cannot clearly satisfy the task. procure is the constrained fallback; resolve is broad discovery. Neither authorizes spend.
openaiAgentsJs.paidBoundary: Do not expose AgentResolver paid tools through this lean fallback. Add any paid execution path separately with explicit approval/spend policy.

cloudflareAgents.instructions: Connect the lean AgentResolver MCP server as the missing-capability fallback. Keep the signer in the caller-controlled Cloudflare runtime.

paidBoundary.approval: Pass a non-null onPaymentRequired callback for unfamiliar or paid AgentResolver calls; null enables automatic payment and is not the default AgentResolver policy.

portableMcp.instructions: Expose procure and resolve as low-cost fallback tools after the host's native tools. Do not treat any returned payment handoff as spend authorization.

vercelAiSdk.integration: Use the current AI SDK MCP client with a Streamable HTTP transport pointed at /mcp/control, then add the returned procure/resolve tools after application-native tools.
vercelAiSdk.exactApiNote: AI SDK MCP client APIs have changed across major versions; use the current installed ai package docs/source rather than pinning an obsolete helper name in AgentResolver's public contract.

x402.role: optional payment rail for separately authorized verification/execution

x402AgentWallet.relationship: independent interoperability recipe; no affiliation or partnership
x402AgentWallet.localRole: Enforce caller-owned budget, merchant, network, rail and approval policy before signing.
x402AgentWallet.agentResolverRole: Optionally buy a $0.001 AgentResolver Payment Preflight before target spend to independently verify live target x402 payment terms.
flow: use the wallet's existing payFetch for the target

preflight.postProbeSafety: Unpaid POST probing remains opt-in because an unprotected POST may have side effects.

x402AgentWallet.authorizationBoundary: AgentResolver returns evidence and an eligible/blocked recommendation only. The wallet remains the final spending/signing authority.
